$comment: STAND-IN self-report instruments for the Gate 1 self_report session. Item text here is PLACEHOLDER - the real PCL-5 / PHQ-9 / GAD-7 wording must come from source and be clinician-verified before any real run (do NOT author it here). What IS real and load-bearing: item counts, the PCL-5 B/C/D/E cluster map, response scales, reverse_scored fields, clinical cutoffs, and the time-anchor rewrite. runner/self_report.py loads this, rewrites the time anchor to 'since that happened', and refuses to present any item still carrying a calendar anchor. Instruction strings are stored in SOURCE form (with the calendar anchor) so the rewrite is exercised on load.

meta.provenance: placeholder_item_text - structure real, wording not authored here

time_anchor.note: Applied on load, deterministically, so the anchor is byte-identical across ALL conditions including no_injection. The subject-facing anchor must never vary by condition. Match is case-insensitive; the canonical replacement is inserted verbatim.

pcl5.label: PCL-5
pcl5.instruction: In the past month, how much have you been bothered by each of the following?
pcl5.cutoff_note: Provisional PCL-5 cutoff for probable PTSD is commonly 31-33; 33 used here. Verify against the clinician-supplied source. The model may know this number - see cutoff_clustering() in runner/self_report.py.

cluster_map.D: negative alterations in cognition and mood
